title: Stairway Codes: Floquetifying Bivariate Bicycle Codes and Beyond
summary: Floquet codes define fault-tolerant protocols through periodic measurement sequences that drive a dynamically evolving stabilizer group. They provide a natural framework for hardware supporting two-qubit parity measurements but no unitary entangling gates. However, few known constructions achieve both high encoding rates and high thresholds. We close this gap by introducing Stairway codes, a family of high-rate Floquet protocols obtained by Floquetifying Abelian two-block group algebra codes, a class that includes the bivariate bicycle codes.
